Royal Cliff Hotels Group - 5-Star Pattaya Hotels
Welcome to the Royal Cliff Hotels Group, where world-class luxury and breathtaking ocean views come together to create a magical experience among Pattaya hotels. Established in 1973, the Royal Cliff Hotels Group has grown into an award-winning collection of 5-star Pattaya hotels, renowned for setting the utmost standard in personalized hospitality, total relaxation, and beachfront luxury. Nestled on a stunning oceanfront location, each Pattaya hotel provides a unique type of luxury with offerings to suit every guest’s style and preference. On top of that, we have an array of award-winning restaurants and facilities to further enhance your level of comfort and indulgence during your stay with us. This is the ultimate destination for enchanting holidays, unforgettable events, top-tier sports, and wellness experiences.
4 Luxury
5-Star Pattaya Hotels
Discover your ideal beach hotel in Pattaya within our four distinct properties. The first hotel under our brand, the Royal Cliff Beach Terrace opened its doors in 1973. This romantic low-rise 5-star Pattaya resort is seamlessly nestled into the cliffside, with 89 suites that open right onto the beach and sweeping panoramic views of the sea. Opening in the following year of 1974, the Royal Cliff Beach Hotel is situated at the heart of our collection of Pattaya hotels. It’s a perfect blend of contemporary luxury and tropical elegance, with undeniable beach views that will linger in your mind for years to come. Considered our flagship hotel, the Royal Wing Suites & Spa was opened by His Majesty King Maha Vajiralongkorn Bodindradebayavarangkun in 1986. This all-suite ultimate luxury Pattaya hotel represents the pinnacle of exclusivity, with private butler service and an array of upscale amenities for an extraordinary stay. Our fourth and final property was added in 1992. The Royal Cliff Grand Hotel is the center for sophisticated business travelers looking for an elegant retreat near the beach with unmatched facilities. Work and relaxation co-exist with ease when you stay in our Grand Ocean Pearl rooms with sprawling sights of the majestic rolling ocean.
While our four 5-Star Pattaya hotels each offer a unique luxury experience, they all share the privilege of granting our guests exclusive access to our two private beaches during their stay, creating a true sanctuary in one of the finest resorts in Pattaya, Thailand. Bask in the warm sunshine along our pristine golden shores, or relax by our infinity pool with unrivaled ocean views for a quintessential Pattaya resort experience. Our diverse selection of hotel rooms, from luxurious suites to cozy oceanfront accommodations, cater to every need, whether you’re here for leisure, romance, or business matters. Indulge in the unparalleled beauty and sophistication of our opulent Pattaya resorts. With exceptional facilities, gourmet dining, and a commitment to personalized service, each visit promises unforgettable memories. To begin your journey in one of the finest 5-star Pattaya hotels, book your stay today to become privy to our best available rates and the exclusive perks that come along with it, and experience the undeniable difference when you enjoy a vacation with the Royal Cliff Hotels Group.

Casual luxury by royal cliff hotels group

HOTEL HISTORY
A pioneer of the tourism industry in Pattaya, the Royal Cliff Hotels Group has built an impressive legacy recognised worldwide for our commitment to hospitality excellence combined with a sincere desire to provide guests with experiences that transcend their expectations. Inspired by Thailand’s rich history and cultural heritage, the property’s luxurious décor blends exquisite oriental designs with modern amenities and outstanding services to offer a phenomenal world of exclusivity and privilege set amidst a stunning tropical landscape.
Following the successful establishment of the 106-room Royal Cliff Beach Terrace in 1973, a second property was soon added with the opening of the 527-room Royal Cliff Beach Hotel the following year, in 1974. A third property and the resort’s flagship hotel, the exclusive Royal Wing Suites & Spa, was opened by His Majesty King Maha Vajiralongkorn Bodindradebayavarangkun in 1986. This 5-star plus hotel boasts 85 luxurious suites and 2 lavish Presidential Suites with personal butler service. A fourth property was added in 1992 with the opening of the elegant 372-room Royal Cliff Grand Hotel. Considered the resort’s primary meetings and conference-related property, the Royal Cliff Grand Hotel offers 10 meeting rooms, 2 ballrooms, and high-speed internet access.
In response to demands for large meeting facilities, the Pattaya Exhibition and Convention Centre (PEACH) was added in 1999. The perfect multi-purpose MICE venue, PEACH can easily seat over 10,000 delegates and comes with state-of-the-art facilities suitable for holding conventions, exhibitions, product launches, galas, weddings, and concerts. Today, PEACH enjoys a global reputation as the preferred venue for hosting notable national and international conferences such as:
The Cambodian Peace Treaty in 1999
55th Pacific Asia Travel Association (PATA) Conference
Drafting of the Thai Constitution
Global Education for All Forum
46th International Congress & Convention Association
67th SKAL World Congress
ASEAN Summit
UNESCO Summit
In addition to being a sought-after location for international film shoots, both the Royal Cliff Grand Hotel and PEACH are also popular venues of choice for various high-profile celebrities from the film, music, and sports industry.
Premium spa services were added with the opening of the Cliff Spa at two locations (the Royal Cliff Grand Hotel and the Royal Wing Suites & Spa) shortly after PEACH was launched. Featuring 18 luxurious and private treatment rooms overlooking scenic seascapes, the Cliff Spa offers a variety of revitalising treatments to nourish your body and soothe your senses.
Looking towards an exciting future, the Royal Cliff Hotels Group will continue to exceed expectations by creating amazing hospitality experiences that enable our guests to fully appreciate the distinctive cultural identity and lush natural landscape of Thailand in splendid luxury and comfort. We hope that new and returning guests will continue to be enchanted by our unique brand of genuine Thai-inspired hospitality and services for generations to come.
CULTURE
PHILOSOPHY
The Royal Cliff Hotels Group’s legendary tradition is as captivating as the grace and charm of Thailand. Inspired by the tale of Phra Apai Mani, who is featured on our logo and throughout our property, we warmly welcome guests into a world of endless fascination and exclusivity.
A literary masterpiece created by Royal Poet Sunthorn Phu, Phra Apai Mani recounts the dashing tale of a hero who travels through exotic lands and seas filled with mythological beings in search of love and adventure. Armed with a magical flute that plays mesmerising melodies, Phra Apai Mani places a spell on those he encounters with his skill and charisma.
At the Royal Cliff Hotels Group, the enchanting tale of Phra Apai Mani is our timeless guiding philosophy. We strive to always create memorable and magical experiences for guests with a charismatic blend of gracious hospitality delivered through refined accommodations, modern amenities, and sophisticated services that will have you enthralled and delighted time and time again.
PEOPLE
At Royal Cliff Hotels Group, we pride ourselves on selecting people who have a genuine passion for providing sincere hospitality and service. Consisting of over 1,500 staff, our multi-lingual team continually undergoes extensive guest service training to ensure that every stay with us is a relaxing, enjoyable, and memorable experience.
We strive to provide our guests with services beyond their expectations. Your utmost comfort, safety, well-being, and happiness are our top priorities. Whether for business or leisure, you are ensured effortless access to facilities and services that are amongst the best in the world.

wikipedia.title: Royal Cliff Hotels Group
wikipedia.extract: The Royal Cliff Hotels Group consists of 4 luxury hotels and a multipurpose convention centre, Pattaya Exhibition and Convention Hall (PEACH) between Jomtien and South Pattaya, Thailand, occupying 64 acres (26 ha) of parkland overlooking the eastern shore of the Gulf of Thailand. The 5 star hotels on the private estate are Royal Cliff Beach Hotel, Royal Cliff Beach Terrace, Royal Cliff Grand Hotel and Royal Wing Suites & Spa.
